image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a vibrant yellow-orange coral fungus (Ramaria or Clavulinopsis species) growing on a forest floor. The fungus features a dense cluster of upright, cylindrical branches that divide repeatedly into finer tips, resembling marine coral. It is surrounded by green moss, dark decaying leaves, and small twigs, creating a natural woodland context.
